messages:
Maya (Product): quick sync — we need to finalize microbundle caps for v1 launch impact doc. Proposed default: 50k tokens/day, per-endpoint QPS 25, burst 5x. Thoughts?
Sam (Sales): can we make a higher ceiling for pilot customers? Acme asked for 200k/day.
Jun (Eng): perf-wise 25 QPS per endpoint is fine if we cap token length to 2k, otherwise KV cache + memory spikes.
Lena (Legal): want to avoid any "unlimited" wording; need explicit overage terms and an auto-throttle clause.
Priya (Customer Success): CS prefers soft caps + in-product alerts and an automatic temporary burst for onboarding (so we don't surprise customers).
Maya (Product): framing: Option A = strict enforced caps w/ billed overage. Option B = soft caps w/ rate-limited grace window + optional paid burst. Which aligns with GTM?
Sam (Sales): sales votes Option B for net-new logos. We can upsell a prepay commit for larger pilots to avoid operational risk.
Jun (Eng): implementation notes — enforcement + telemetry required. Minimal config prototype:
```
microbundle {
  daily_token_cap: 50000
  qps_per_endpoint: 25
  burst_multiplier: 5
  soft_cap_grace_window: 72h
}
```
We can gate burst by token-length heuristics.
Maya (Product): rollout criteria for GA: feature-flagged, <1% of requests throttled, latency regression <2%, cost delta within forecast, runbook + alerting in place.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to canary cluster at 04:00 UTC tomorrow :rocket:
Sam (Sales): for Acme specifically propose exception: 200k/day for 30 days if they prepay the month. @Lena can we encode that in a temporary contract addendum?
Lena (Legal): yes — will draft an exception clause: "temporary capacity exceptions subject to prepayment and 30d termination notice" and include a revocation path.
Priya (Customer Success): need UI affordances: clear usage meter, soft-cap banner, 1-click request-for-burst flow that notifies ops. Also email templates for alerts.
Jun (Eng): rough estimate: 2 sprints to add enforcement hooks, telemetry + metrics, and the UI endpoint for burst requests (assuming one engineer pair).
Maya (Product): decision for roadmap slot: go with Option B (soft caps + paid overages) for GA; contract exceptions handled case-by-case. Need eng + legal sign-off by EOD Friday to keep the release on the next train. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Sales): +1, will escalate with Acme to sign prepay.
Jun (Eng): +1, will block sprint.
Lena (Legal): +1, will circulate draft this afternoon.
Priya (Customer Success): will prepare alert copy and the onboarding flow checklist.
Maya (Product): thanks team — I'll update the product PRD and route the launch criteria to roadmap tracker."
